title: In My Town, Every Footstep Glows With Your Body Heat
revision_note: r3 (2026-11-19, owner-approved ending): narration from 'I jumped the night van.' replaced; 'Then' cut from beats 18 and 36 to hold 182 words. Old beats 41-51 (van drive-off, home print-warming, comic radio sting) replaced by 41-56: van skids onto the frozen lake east of town, heat melts the ice, Striders sink; driver runs, blazing prints, grey hand bursts through ice (hard cut, non-graphic), radio left crackling on the ice; Theo's bandaged feet; June carries him home piggyback at dusk, her small orange prints glowing. Beats 1-40 t values unchanged (voice_subs.py snaps). PREVIOUS r2 NOTE: r2 length trim: real viral_storyteller voice = 184 WPM, 203 words ran 66.7 s. Narration cut to 176 words (target ~57.7 s at 3.05 w/s), all 51 beats and sfx kept. Verifier r1 notes: June's orange prints shown fading in beat 43 ('June's faded.') before the Striders ignore them in 45; driver's scream staged comic in beat 51. r1: night van planted (2, 14), VAN 7 radio planted (15).
timing_note: planned at ~3.05 words/s (measured viral_storyteller 184 WPM); final t/dur snap to Faster-Whisper word times from pipeline/voice_subs.py

sets.dusk_road: Set_Street002 shot at dusk (G.dusk, ClockTime 17.6), snowy road, June's small orange prints
